model: GNU BF524 with documented D-register deferred-writeback patch; not hardware validation
limitations: Complete isolated render, including scheduled wave update, for the tested nonnegative control domain. Wider green/white words are stress coverage, not a claim about physical knob ranges.

The external update counter, active flag, callbacks, pitch buffer and schedule are explicit inputs. No original allocator, pitch calibration/provider, ADSR, output conversion, physical timing or plugin integration claimed.
Sine source words are explicitly copied by the harness; full original sine initialization is not executed.

validation.independent_reproduction: Two new private output directories; full inputs and original outputs agree byte for byte.
validation.windows_wine: MSVC-target cross-build; new spectral/kernel tests and reused reader test passed under Wine. Not native Windows/Ableton/ASIO validation.
validation.sanitizers: Both new tests passed ASan+UBSan; LeakSanitizer disabled because of sandbox ptrace limitation.
validation.runtime_linkage: New headers are reached only by pure-core tests. Reader body shared with complete isolated adapter; original reader regression still passes. No instrument executable, selector, MIDI/host parameter IDs or presets changed.
